messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about International politics and organisations in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Greece, Spain, Finland, France, Ireland, Italy, Luxembourg, Netherlands, Austria, Portugal, Sweden, United Kingdom, Bulgaria, Cyprus, Czech Republic, Estonia, Hungary, Latvia, Lithuania, Malta, Poland, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, and Croatia during the 2010s?
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: Eurobarometer data archive 2010 2019 EU member countries international politics European Union
Chapel Hill expert survey 2010 2014 2019 EU integration dataset
European Social Survey data 2010 2018 political trust international organisations countries
action.query: Eurobarometer data archive 2010 2019 EU member countries international politics European Union

queries: GESIS Eurobarometer data service survey search 2010 2019
European Social Survey data portal rounds 5 9
European Parliament election studies 2014 2019 data EES
Eurostat international organisations EU government expenditure foreign affairs datasets
action.query: GESIS Eurobarometer data service survey search 2010 2019

content.text: {"items":[{"title":"Eurobarometer Survey Data (2010–2019) – European Commission and GESIS","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/eurobarometer-data-service","justification":"One of the most comprehensive sources for studying international politics and organisations across all 28 countries specified. Includes surveys conducted throughout 2010–2019 covering public attitudes toward the European Union, European integration, EU institutions, international relations, foreign policy, migration, democracy, and political trust. Particularly suitable because all requested countries were EU members by 2013, including Croatia. Provides comparable country-level and individual-level survey data."},{"title":"Eurobarometer Primary Data and Documentation – GESIS","url_or_doi":"https://www.gesis.org/en/eurobarometer-data-service/data-and-documentation","justification":"Provides access to individual Eurobarometer datasets, questionnaires, codebooks, and survey documentation from the 2010s. Researchers can identify surveys addressing international organisations, European institutions, EU foreign policy, international cooperation, and political attitudes. Covers the requested EU member states, with Croatia included following its accession in 2013."},{"title":"Eurobarometer 74.2: Europe 2020, the Financial and Economic Crisis, and Information on European Political Matters (2010)","url_or_doi":"https://www.icpsr.umich.edu/web/ICPSR/studies/34242","justification":"A specific cross-national survey dataset from November–December 2010 examining European political affairs, the Europe 2020 strategy, and the financial and economic crisis. Relevant for analysing public perceptions of European governance, supranational institutions, and international political cooperation at the beginning of the decade. Covers EU member states participating in the survey."},{"title":"European Social Survey (ESS), Rounds 5–9 (2010–2018)","url_or_doi":"https://ess.nsd.no/en/series/321b06ad-1b98-4b7d-93ad-ca8a24e8788a","justification":"Provides harmonised cross-national survey data collected approximately every two years, including rounds conducted in 2010, 2012, 2014, 2016, and 2018. Contains measures of trust in the European Parliament, the United Nations, national political institutions, political participation, immigration attitudes, and European identity. Includes many of the requested countries, although participation varies by survey round. Particularly useful for comparing attitudes toward international organisations during the 2010s."},{"title":"Chapel Hill Expert Survey (CHES) – European Political Parties and EU Integration","url_or_doi":"https://www.chesdata.eu/ches-europe/","justification":"Provides expert assessments of European political parties' positions on European integration, EU policies, ideology, and related international political questions. Includes survey waves from 2010, 2014, and 2019, making it particularly relevant to the requested decade. Covers political parties across EU member states, including Central and Eastern European countries. Useful for analysing national political actors' relationships with supranational institutions and European integration."},{"title":"Chapel Hill Expert Survey Trend File, 1999–2019","url_or_doi":"https://researchdata.essex.ac.uk/145/","justification":"A harmonised longitudinal dataset combining Chapel Hill Expert Survey waves from 1999, 2002, 2006, 2010, 2014, and 2019. Includes political party positions on European integration, specific EU policies, and ideological orientations. Particularly valuable for comparing changes in political party attitudes toward European institutions across countries during the 2010s."},{"title":"European Parliament Election Study 2014 – Voter Study, First Post-Election Survey","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5160?lang=en","justification":"Provides individual-level electoral and political attitude data collected following the 2014 European Parliament elections. Covers the 28 EU member states, matching the requested country list. Includes information about European political participation, electoral behaviour, political preferences, and attitudes toward European integration. Especially suitable for studying relationships between citizens, national political systems, and supranational democratic institutions."},{"title":"European Parliament Election Study 2014 – Voter Study, Supplementary Study","url_or_doi":"https://search.gesis.org/research_data/ZA5161?lang=de","justification":"A supplementary dataset associated with the 2014 European Parliament elections. Contains measures relating to trust in EU institutions, European citizenship, identification with Europe, and perceptions of the European Parliament. Useful for investigating political legitimacy, supranational identity, and public attitudes toward European organisations during the middle of the 2010s."},{"title":"Varieties of Democracy (V-Dem) – Historical Country-Year Datasets","url_or_doi":"https://www.v-dem.net/en/data/archive/previous-data/v-dem-dataset/","justification":"Provides longitudinal country-year datasets containing extensive indicators of democracy, political institutions, electoral systems, civil society, political accountability, and governance. Covers all 28 requested countries throughout 2010–2019. Particularly useful for comparing institutional and political developments across European countries and examining how national political systems relate to broader international democratic governance. Historical dataset versions can be accessed through the archive."},{"title":"European Observatory of Political Trust – Cross-National Political Trust Data","url_or_doi":"https://trustobservatory.eu/wp/?page_id=394","justification":"Provides cross-national data on political trust and related institutional indicators for 44 European countries over the period 1980–2023, encompassing the entire 2010s. Integrates information from Eurobarometer, the European Social Survey, the European Values Study, the World Values Survey, and other sources. Relevant for investigating confidence in political institutions, democracy, government accountability, and institutional legitimacy across the requested European countries. Country and year availability should be checked for individual indicators."},{"title":"InDivEU – Political Party Preferences on Differentiated European Integration","url_or_doi":"https://cris.unibo.it/handle/11585/1037430","justification":"A research dataset addressing political party preferences concerning differentiated European integration. Incorporates information from the Chapel Hill Expert Survey waves of 2010, 2014, and 2019, alongside additional assessments of party positions. Particularly relevant for studying how political parties across European countries view participation in EU institutions, differentiated membership arrangements, and supranational governance. Useful for analysing international political cooperation and competing visions of European integration during the 2010s."},{"title":"Eurostat – General Government Expenditure by Function (COFOG)","url_or_doi":"https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/databrowser/view/gov_10a_exp/default/table?lang=en","justification":"Provides comparable government expenditure statistics by function for European countries, including historical observations covering the 2010s. Relevant categories include general public services and foreign affairs-related expenditure, where separately available in the underlying classification. Useful for comparing the financial dimensions of international political engagement and public administration across the requested countries. The dataset is primarily financial rather than a direct measure of international organisations or diplomatic activity."}]}
